description: Search the federal dam register (SFOE, ~225 dams) by dam, reservoir or facility name, purpose (hydroelectricity, flood protection, irrigation, …) or dam type (arch, gravity, embankment, …), ranked by height, volume, crest length or year built. With no filters it ranks all dams, e.g. the tallest or largest. Examples: {query:'Dixence'}, {sort_by:'volume'}, {purpose:'flood'}.

purpose.description: e.g. hydroelectricity, flood protection, irrigation, drinking water

query.description: Dam, reservoir or facility name (partial, accents optional)

name: search_dams
title: Search and rank Swiss dams
